title: Annual financial statements with CPA report
description: Annual statements with the accountant's review or audit report, labeled by assurance level.

title: Quarterly runway attestation with bank confirmation
description: Signed statement of cash, net burn, runway and committed funding, with a bank balance confirmation.
notes: Bank confirmation is third-party; projections are first-party.

title: Escrow deposit receipts and verification report
description: Agent receipt for each release deposit and the agent's build or deployment verification report.

title: UCC and lien search
description: Search of Indiana UCC filings and tax liens against the company.
producer: Indiana Secretary of State UCC records (requested by customer or Echelon)

title: Export round-trip test result
description: Per-release result of exporting a full tenant dataset and validating completeness and re-import into a reference schema.

title: Wind-down plan and reserve evidence
description: Written wind-down plan, reserve calculation and annual review record.

title: Monthly bank reconciliation and approval log
description: Monthly reconciliation of company accounts with reviewer identity, and bank approval logs for disbursements above threshold.

title: Financial event notification log
description: Record of financial events and notices sent to customers with dates.
